data.name: Police Detective: Tokyo Beat
data.detailed_description:
The chief's mad at you, so you'd better work hard to get back on his good side!

Start at the bottom, and work your way up to the toughest cases in Tokyo.

Interview victims, suspects and witnesses to learn about their lives, their motives and their complex relationships.

Analyze physical evidence to see what matches up with your witness statements.

Who's being straight with you, and who has something to hide?

The truth isn't always what it seems!

Features:
-Solve a series of murder-mystery-style criminal cases, each more tricky than the last!
-Enjoy an atmospheric visual novel game, with diverse locations and captivating ambience.
-Speak to a range of unique characters, all with their own quirks and engaging back-stories.
-Use your notebook to easily review what you've found out, before you decide who's guilty.
-Replay cases to try and get a perfect rank for each one. Select the most relevant evidence, and use police time efficiently, to become a highly-rated detective.

Your keen eye will learn to spot important clues and red herrings, leading you to a shortlist of suspects.

Your instinct will help you identify the culprit, then you'll filter through the evidence to make sure they face justice.

So look sharp, detective!

Keep your ear to the ground, stay hot on the trail, and try to keep up with the Tokyo beat.
